raw_html: [[Lightning Strike#Sovereign Lightning Strike|Sovereign Lightning Strike]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Lightning Strike#Sovereign Lightning Strike|Sovereign Lightning Strike]]:''' This item crackles with power, flickers of lightning emanating from it. On a strike of a Natural 20 that is confirmed as a critical hit, this item will strike your foe with a tremendous burst of lightning. A DC 100 [[Reflex save]] will prevent half of this damage.
